.3 śodhanam शोधनम्
Processing raw ingredients to optimize safety and efficacy

ITA-9.2.1 saṁśodhanakarma, śodhanakarma, śodhana cikitsa संशोधनकर्म, शोधनकर्म, शोधन चिकित्सा
Cleansing therapy
Treatment modality based on the principle of removing vitiated doṣa.

ITA-9.5.89 śodhanakavalaḥ शोधनकवलः
Mouth gargle with cleansing property
A type of gargle with the property of removing morbid dosha.

ITA-9.5.84 śodhanagaṇḍūṣaḥ शोधनगण्डू षः
Retention of medications with cleansing property in the oral cavity
Full mouth retention of liquid medications with the property of removing morbid dosha for a specific time.

ITA-9.5.76 śodhanadhūmapānam शोधनधूमपानम्
Medicated smoking with cleansing effect
The procedure of medicated smoking to remove morbid dosha through the nasal and/or oral cavity.
